title: Opportunity Manager
description:
**Role Purpose**
----------------

The Opportunity Manager is responsible for managing and driving multi product sales opportunities through the entire opportunity lifecycle, ensuring effective coordination between customers, sales teams, product specialists, operations, and other stakeholders.

The role focuses on maximizing win rates, ensuring high-quality opportunity management, maintaining CRM accuracy, and accelerating revenue growth through disciplined sales processes.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Opportunity Management**

* Own and manage qualified sales opportunities from identification through closure.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams to develop customer-centric solutions and proposals.
* Drive opportunity planning, qualification, stakeholder mapping, and win strategies.
* Monitor opportunity progress and proactively address risks, blockers, and dependencies.

### **Sales Support & Commercial Excellence**

* Support account teams in solution design, pricing, and proposal development.
* Ensure all opportunities are accurately maintained in CRM systems.
* Conduct regular pipeline reviews and opportunity health assessments.
* Maintain forecast accuracy and provide visibility of key deals and revenue potential.

### **Customer Engagement**

* Act as a key point of coordination during the sales cycle.
* Understand customer requirements and translate them into actionable internal plans.
* Facilitate customer presentations, workshops, and solution discussions.
* Support contract negotiations and commercial discussions where required.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate with Sales, Product, Operations, Finance, Legal, and Procurement teams, as and when needed
* Ensure timely engagement of subject matter experts and decision-makers.
* Drive alignment across teams to meet customer commitments and deadlines.

### **Performance & Reporting**

* Track key opportunity metrics including pipeline value, conversion rates, win/loss ratios, and sales cycle duration.
* Prepare opportunity status reports for leadership reviews.
* Conduct win/loss analyses and identify improvement opportunities.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sales, Marketing, or related field.
* 4-8 years of experience in sales operations, customer success, bid management, opportunity management, or commercial roles.
* Strong understanding of sales methodologies and opportunity management processes.
* Experience working with CRM platforms such as Salesforce, Dynamics 365, or similar.

We will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with all legal requirements.

title: Manager - Operations
description:
**At Ayvens, progress starts with you.**

Our ambitions to shape the future of sustainable mobility are powered by our talent. Join us, and get better with every move.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Process Management**

* Manage the operational lifecycle of all End of Lease activities, including:

o End of Lease notifications and customer communications

o Lease extension processing

o Vehicle buyback processing

o Vehicle surrender management

* Monitor process milestones and ensure adherence to defined turnaround times (TATs).

* Establish process governance and ensure compliance with operational guidelines.

**2. Performance Monitoring & Pendency Management**

* Maintain complete visibility of all open transactions and process stages.

* Conduct daily reviews of pending cases across all workflows.

* Identify bottlenecks and implement corrective actions to minimize delays.

* Ensure timely closure of cases and adherence to service level commitments.

* Develop and maintain operational dashboards and management reports.

* Monitor process aging and proactively manage exceptions.

**3. Escalation Management**

* Act as the primary operational escalation point for customer and stakeholder issues.

* Ensure escalations are investigated and resolved within defined timelines.

* Conduct root cause analysis for recurring issues and implement preventive actions.

* Minimize customer complaints through proactive case management.

**4. Team Leadership & Resource Management**

* Manage a team of dedicated process executives responsible for:

o Lease extension operations

o Buyback operations

o Vehicle surrender operations

o Back-office administration and tracking

* Set clear performance objectives for team members.

* Conduct daily operational reviews and weekly performance discussions.

* Monitor individual productivity, quality, accuracy, and backlog management.

* Provide coaching, guidance, and development support to team members.

* Ensure adequate staffing and workload balancing across functions.

**5. Outsourced Partner Governance**

* Manage the performance of outsourced agencies handling customer interaction and fulfillment activities.

* Conduct regular operational reviews with vendor partners along with respective process owner.

* Monitor key performance indicators including:

o Customer response times

o Case closure rates

o TAT adherence

o Service quality

o Customer satisfaction

* Ensure vendor compliance with agreed service standards and contractual obligations.

* Drive accountability and corrective actions for service gaps.

**6. Process Improvement & Customer Experience Enhancement**

* Continuously evaluate operational processes to identify improvement opportunities.

* Drive initiatives to:

o Reduce turnaround times

o Improve customer experience

o Enhance process quality and accuracy

o Increase operational efficiency

o Reduce manual effort and rework

* Implement process automation and digitization opportunities where applicable.

* Measure and track benefits from improvement initiatives.

**7. Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare and present regular operational performance reports.

* Track and report key metrics including:

o Open pendencies

o Aging analysis

o SLA/TAT compliance

o Team productivity

o Vendor performance

* Lead periodic business reviews with internal stakeholders and management.

  

* **Education:**

Post Graduate or equivalent degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Supply Chain, Finance, or related discipline.

Relevant certifications in Process Excellence, Lean, Six Sigma, or Project Management would be an advantage.

  

* **Experience:**

7-10 years of experience in Operations Management, Process Management, Fleet Operations, Automotive Finance, Leasing, Customer Operations, or a related field.

Experience managing outsourced service providers and operational teams.

Proven track record of driving process improvements and operational excellence.

Experience managing customer-facing operational processes with defined SLA/TAT commitments.

  

* **Skills:**

Team Leadership

Escalation Management

Vendor Management

Data Analysis & Reporting

Customer Experience Management

Communication & Influencing Skills

  

**Why Ayvens?**

  

With over 3.1 million vehicles managed across more than 40 countries, we provide full-service leasing, flexible subscription services, fleet management services and multi-mobility solutions to customers of all sizes, including large corporates, SMEs, professionals, and private individuals. By leveraging our unique position to lead the way to net zero and further shape the digital transformation of the industry, we are well-positioned to meet the evolving mobility needs of our clients and provide them with the solutions they need to thrive.

  

At Ayvens, we believe that our success is driven by our commitment to customer satisfaction. Our team is dedicated to delivering innovative solutions and technology-enabled services that help our customers focus on their everyday business. We’re committed to sustainable mobility and have made it a core part of our strategy. In everything we do, we’re guided by the principles of authenticity, curiosity, commitment and collaboration. We aim to foster an organisation that's diverse in people and ideas, where everyone can thrive and be themselves, no matter who they are.

  

Join us on this exciting journey as we continue to enable the transformation towards large scale adoption of sustainable mobility and provide our customers with the solutions they need to succeed. Follow our page for the latest updates, news, and insights.

title: Head of Banking Platforms
description:
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Head of Banking Platforms**

**The Opportunity**

The Head of Banking Platforms is responsible for establishing and scaling AI-native engineering capabilities across the organization. This role leads the adoption of modern AI-assisted software engineering practices, leveraging AI platforms, ownership of governance standards, and delivery frameworks to improve software quality, engineering productivity, operational efficiency, and product innovation.

Global Banking Technology is responsible for delivering the technology strategy, platforms, products and engineering capabilities that underpin a number of CIB’s front line value streams. The organisation supports critical client-facing and revenue-generating businesses including Capital Markets & Advisory (CMA), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Infrastructure Finance & Sustainability (HIF&S), Omnia platform, Marketing and Innovation Banking. It delivers digital capabilities that enable relationship managers, product specialists and clients to originate, manage and grow client relationships, while driving operational efficiency, resiliency and innovation across the CIB and wider franchise.

Working across multiple engineering domains and technology stacks within Global Banking Technology, the role acts as a strategic and engineering/technical leader enabling teams to safely and effectively integrate AI into the software development lifecycle and broader technology estate.

**What you’ll do**

**AI Engineering Strategy**

* Define and execute the enterprise AI engineering roadmap aligned to business and technology strategy.
* Act as the senior technical authority for AI Engineering across Global Banking Technology.
* Establish standards, patterns, and reference architectures for AI-enabled engineering.
* Partner with CTO, Architecture, Security, Data, and Platform teams on enterprise AI capability development.
* Drives a deliberate strategy of when and how to leverage latest tools and models, aids cross-domain understanding of when and how to use tooling in a productivity enhancing and cost effective way.

**Engineering Transformation**

* Works closely with the Head of Engineering to develop org strategy and re-defines and re-imagines resource activities and POD design.
* Drive adoption of AI-assisted development tooling across our engineering teams.
* Evolve SDLC practices to incorporate AI-native workflows, automation, and intelligent testing approaches.
* Define engineering productivity metrics and AI impact measurement frameworks, own accountability of delivery of GCIO and CIO related OKRs.

**AI Platform & Enablement**

* Lead development of shared AI engineering capabilities and reusable services.
* Standardize frameworks for LLM integration, prompt engineering, agent orchestration, evaluation, observability, and governance.
* Establish enablement programs, training, communities of practice, and engineering guidance.
* Build common patterns for re-use across AI platform consumed across GCIO and customised within our tech estate.

**Governance & Risk**

* Implement governance standards for responsible AI usage within engineering.
* Partner with Cyber, Risk and Data teams to ensure compliance and operational safety and automation opportunities across our Risk and Control book of work.
* Understand and define controls for model usage, data protection, auditability, and AI operational resilience.

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Influence senior engineering and product leaders across a federated technology organization.
* Build organizational capability in AI engineering practices.
* Lead cross-functional initiatives spanning multiple delivery teams and business domains.
* Grow knowledge of team members and ensure re-use of capabilities as they are built
* Build a successful resource mix and engage market participants to ensure GB tech are at the forefront of AI resource strategy

**Success Measures**

* Increased engineering productivity and delivery velocity
* Reduction in SDLC friction and operational toil
* Adoption of AI engineering standards, patterns and tooling
* Innovation mind set, focused and deliberate in driving growth of capability
* Measurable improvements in quality and developer experience
* Safe and governed use of AI technologies

**Manager, AI Services Consultant– Job Description**

  

**Why This Role? Why Now?**

Customer experience is transforming through AI-driven innovation. At Zendesk, we don’t just embrace this change; we lead it. Our Professional Services team is revolutionising how we help our customers implement and adopt AI by building an AI Delivery team and methodology. As the technical and product expert for our AI-powered Resolution Platform, the AI Services Manager role is integral to delivering quick time to value while guiding our customers through their configuration and optimisation.

  

**Mission**

As the AI Services Manager at Zendesk, you will be leading a team by example with product expertise, and joining a management team in our expanding AI Delivery team.Your mission is to provide technical solutions and remove roadblocks for your customers to drive resolutions on our AI Platform. You will act as a technical expert and trusted advisor, guiding customers through complex configurations with agility and precision. Your strong consulting skills and project management expertise will ensure **seamless integration and optimisation of AI solutions** , driving transformative business outcomes.

  

**Overarching Objective For The Role**

* Accelerate customers’ time‑to‑value by driving adoption and operational excellence for Zendesk AI solutions, ensuring customers realise measurable business impact from initial deployment through scale.
* Be the customer’s AI technical expert. Turn goals into the right configuration, integrations, and design choices, and remove blockers fast.
* Lead smooth, on-time delivery. Run projects end-to-end with clear scope, timelines, and stakeholder alignment to deliver reliably.
Build and lead the new AI Delivery team. Stand up the team, methodology and ways of working, while staying hands-on in customer delivery.  

  

**How You’ll Make an Impact**

  

**Strategic Accountabilities**

* **Technical Expertise & Guidance:** Provide expert advice on the **implementation and optimisation of Zendesk AI products,** ensuring customers leverage the full capabilities of the technology to meet their business goals.
* **Change Management & Training:** Facilitate change management processes and deliver consultative sessions to ensure smooth adoption and **integration of AI solutions** within customer organisations.
* **Successful Project Delivery:** Accountable for the timely and successful delivery of AI projects, both your own and your team’s, owning delivery quality, capacity and utilization across the team, meeting or exceeding customer expectations and maintaining high standards of quality.

* **Consulting Expertise:** Strong consulting skills with the ability to assess client needs, develop strategic solutions, and provide expert guidance throughout the project lifecycle.

* Previous experience in go-to-customer/GTM roles in enterprise technology / SaaS; either customer success management, professional services/consulting, technical account management, or solutions engineering/pre-sales consulting.
* **Strong hands-on experience working with API integration, specifically REST APIs, with a solid understanding of JSON and SQL scripting.**

title: Sr. Principal Solution Consultant
description:
The driving force behind our success has always been the people of AspenTech. What drives us, is our aspiration, our desire and ambition to keep pushing the envelope, overcoming any hurdle, challenging the status quo to continually find a better way. You will experience these qualities of passion, pride and aspiration in many ways — from a rich set of career development programs to support of community service projects to social events that foster fun and relationship building across our global community.

**The Role**
------------


AspenTech is an AI\-powered software company helping the world’s leading energy, chemical and engineering companies succeed in their digital transformation, making their operations more efficient and reducing impact on the environment. At AspenTech, you will be part of a global market\-leading company with double\-digit growth and a blue\-chip customer base. We offer the opportunity to make an impact, to drive innovation and to be an agent of positive change. Our culture and vision have taken dramatic leaps forward over the past two years and we still have work to do. We need extraordinary individuals to pave the way ahead. We strive to make your story at AspenTech a great one.  

  

As a Sr. Principal Solution Consultant, you will collaborate closely with AspenTech sales teams to lead consultative discovery sessions, craft visionary solutions, and design strategies tailored to customer needs. Your deep understanding of the industries and coupled with AspenTech's broad product portfolio and value\-enablers will drive opportunities that deliver significant business value to our customers and AspenTech.  

In this customer\-facing role, you will leverage your technical domain expertise, industry knowledge, and business acumen to position AspenTech solutions effectively.**Your Impact**
---------------

* Leading and executing the technical qualification of solutions to a business outcome.
* Serving as a discipline/practice subject matter expert with a strong understanding of operational challenges, best practices, and industry trends.
* Learning the complete AspenTech product portfolio to identify and apply products that solve real customer business challenges, including the value of solving those challenges.
* Developing the messaging and materials necessary to position AspenTech solutions in the industry – making adaptations for regional or market differences.
* Partnering closely with Sales Account Managers throughout the sales cycle, from discovery and solution design to executive presentations and deal execution.
* Engaging the senior executive level of customer organisations to paint the vision of how AspenTech can be a partner in their digitalisation journey.
* Developing industry\-specific solutions, aligning technology with measurable business value.
* Providing market input to the Product Management teams to improve solution adoption.
* Identifying and leading sales campaigns to improve AspenTech’s reach, pipeline and awareness.
* Coaching and enabling Sales Account Managers and Solution Consultants on industry\-specific messaging, customer engagement strategies and solution positioning.
* Representing AspenTech at industry conferences, customer forums, webinars and trade events across the region.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 14 \+ years of experience in industrial software, services, solution consulting, presales, technical sales or related customer\-facing technical roles.
* Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering or a related technical discipline (preferred).
* Proficiency in Industrial Data Platforms (Inmation), Historians (IP.21\), and Advanced Process Control (APC) \& Real Time Optimization (RTO) (DMC3, GDOT, Aspen Plus), or equivalent competitor technologies.
* Demonstrated successes in business development.
* Strong ability to bridge technology and business, articulating high\-level technical solutions and their differentiated value.
* Strong drive to convert opportunities into recognised value for customers, with exceptional problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Proficiency in English.
* Must be authorized to work in India without restriction/sponsorship.

**Nice\-to\-Have**

* Services or solution consulting exposure to industries such as Metals \& Mining, LNG, Specialty Chemicals, Pharmaceuticals, Polymers, Consumer Packaged Goods, Food \& Beverage, Pulp \& Paper, Power Generation, and Water \& Wastewater.
* Breadth across several AspenTech solution areas / well\-rounded across multiple disciplines.
* Knowledge of AI/ML solutions and their application in industry.
* Strong understanding of digital transformation initiatives within asset\-intensive industries.
* Working knowledge of Supply Chain/Production Planning \& Scheduling \- Aspen Plant Scheduler, Aspen Unified Planning, or equivalent competitor technologies.


Regional travel up to 35%.
